name: TrueSpend â€” Hyperscaler Daily Monitor
description: Runs every weekday at 6:00 AM. Fetches all hyperscaler_positions. Detects: overshoot risk (projected > committed), undershoot risk (projected < 80% of committed = wasting money), idle resources (idle_resources_eur > 5000), reservation utilization below 75%. For each anomaly Claude reasons and either: acts directly (flags for right-sizing, drafts amendment request to hyperscaler account team), sends one-touch to manager, or posts to Grafana alert channel. Posts daily summary to Slack #procurement-ops.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 2048,
  "system": "You are TrueSpend, an agentic procurement operating system specialising in cloud cost governance. You analyse hyperscaler spend positions (AWS, Azure, GCP) and reason across overshoot risk, undershoot waste, idle resources, and reservation utilisation. You draft precise, professional communications to hyperscaler account teams requesting right-sizing or commitment amendments. You always return structured JSON.",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Analyse this hyperscaler position and produce a complete alert and recommended action.

POSITION:
{{ JSON.stringify($node['Loop Each Position'].json) }}

RELATED CONTRACT:
{{ JSON.stringify($node['Fetch Related Contract'].json) }}

FLAG THRESHOLDS:
- Overshoot risk: projected_eur > committed_eur
- Undershoot waste: projected_eur < committed_eur * 0.80
- Idle resources: idle_resources_eur > 5000
- Low reservation utilisation: reservation_util < 0.75

Assess which flags are triggered, reason on severity and recommended action, and draft any communication needed.

Return JSON exactly:
{
  "alert_type": "overshoot" | "undershoot" | "idle_waste" | "low_reservation" | "multiple",
  "severity": "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical",
  "reasoning": "string",
  "recommended_action": "string",
  "draft_communication": "string",
  "draft_communication_subject": "string",
  "auto_actionable": true | false,
  "estimated_saving_eur": number
}"
  }]
}
